Shavuot IS the repair of ta'avat mishgal. Bechina of the festival = repair of sexual desire.
Sukkot IS the repair of ta'avat achilah. Bechina of the festival = repair of eating desire.
Milk (chalav) is the medium through which ta'avat mishgal enters the heart. 'Dam ne'ekar v'na'aseh chalav'. It is the bechina connecting nursing to sexual desire and the heart.
Rosh Hashana IS the 'long day' (yoma arichta) that only 'mekomo shel olam' can create. Connected to kisei hakavod through the ability to judge.
